Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0419286 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Need to plan for the site intervention as multiple times the AC charging session was failed during the initial phase of the charging session. Apart from it we have checked the charger remotely using the SSH access and we're not able to ping the AC meter IP address. Please check the power supply to the AC meter as well as please check if the ethernet cables to the AC meter is connected properly. Please carry couple of ethernet cables as well. Below is the screenshot which shows the IP is not reachable due to this the session got aborted. Attaching the logs also for your reference.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.

afonso-sousa@siemens.com
